meta.direction: Propuesta B · editorial · paleta 2 · costa amalfitana
boards: Invitados · Inicio en escritorio · banner de arena

tokens.name: fondo
tokens.usage: Fondo — the page ground on every screen, guest and couple. Also the inset ground of code inputs and the bank-details panel inside a fund card. Dark: deep night navy.

tokens.name: marino
tokens.usage: Marino — the ink. All body and heading text on `fondo`, `blanco`, `lavanda`, `pendiente` and `naranja` (10.9:1 on fondo). Also the dark surface: admin sidebar, success banner, selected segment, the 'Elegida' badge, the dark CTA ('Traer datos'). Dark: becomes the light ink (#e8edfb, 15:1 on fondo); dark fills move to `profundo` and selected states to `seleccion`.

tokens.name: mayolica
tokens.usage: Azul mayólica — action. Primary button fill, every card and input border (2px), links, active tab label, progress fill, checkbox accent, the save-the-date card. White text on it is 6.7:1. Do not use it as text on `lavanda` (3.96:1). Same value in both themes (white text 6.7:1); its border and text roles move to `trazo` and `accion-texto`.

tokens.name: naranja
tokens.usage: Naranja — accent on dark. Active item and count badge in the admin sidebar, the '&' in the sidebar wordmark, the progress fill on a `marino` card, filled rating stars, the success-banner check disc. 5.7:1 against `marino`; never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: rojo
tokens.usage: Rojo — the signature offset shadow under primary buttons (`shadow-offset`), the '&' between the names, and display-size accent words on `fondo` and `blanco` (3.49:1 / 3.56:1, which passes the 3:1 floor for 24px+ type). Never as text on `arena` (2.98:1): there the accent word is set in `rojo-texto` (4.72:1). Never as small text. Kept exactly as the source's 'Rojo · acento'.

tokens.name: lavanda
tokens.usage: Lavanda — quiet surfaces: 'Confirmado' badge, segmented-control track, progress track, avatar discs, icon tiles, the brunch card, the news band. Also the 1px row dividers inside cards (decorative only, 1.69:1 on white). Text on it: `marino` or `texto-lavanda`, never `texto-tenue` (3.98:1). Dark: a muted navy tint (#24365f) for tracks, quiet surfaces and dividers.

tokens.name: blanco
tokens.usage: Card and control surface: every outlined card, input, tab bar, sticky RSVP footer, the 'Familia Pérez' chip. Dark: the raised navy surface (#15233f) — the name is kept for the role, not the hue.

tokens.name: crema
tokens.usage: Ceramic ground — the cream of the majolica tile, the plate and the 'foto' label on photo placeholders. Not a UI surface.

tokens.name: texto-suave
tokens.usage: Secondary text — paragraphs and form labels on `fondo` and `blanco` (8.6:1); unselected segment and quiet-button labels. Dark: #c3cbe3.

tokens.name: texto-tenue
tokens.usage: Muted text — eyebrow section headings, captions, meta lines, inactive tab labels, placeholders' helper copy. On `fondo`/`blanco` only (6.6:1). Dark: #9aa6c6 (7.3:1 on fondo).

tokens.name: texto-lavanda
tokens.usage: Text on `lavanda` surfaces — the brunch card description, the news band and the 'Esta semana' stat (6.65:1). Dark: #dfe5f7.

tokens.name: texto-claro
tokens.usage: Muted text on `mayolica` and `marino` — countdown labels, stat captions, success-banner body (5.25:1 on mayolica).

tokens.name: texto-claro-tenue
tokens.usage: Muted text in the admin sidebar and the navy countdown ('Planificación', 'Narvis y Juan') on `marino` (7.5:1).

tokens.name: rojo-texto
tokens.usage: Red as text: the display accent word on `arena` (desktop hero 'al atardecer', 4.72:1) and all small red text: kicker eyebrows ('Nos casamos', 'Hola, familia Pérez'), news bylines, deadlines ('sáb 14', '12 días'), the ceremony time, '−' cons and '✗ No'. 5.54:1 on `fondo`, 5.64:1 on `blanco`, 4.72:1 on `arena`. Light value nudged from the source's #c73232 so the sand-banner kicker passes 4.5:1. Dark: lifted to #ff8a80 (7.7:1 on fondo).

tokens.name: pendiente
tokens.usage: Soft yellow — 'Pendiente' badge, 'Hora dorada' tag, the 'Por decidir' stat, a person tag ('Juan'). Also the 'Guarda la fecha' eyebrow on `mayolica` (5.36:1). Dark: a deep ochre tint (#43380f) with `marino` text.

tokens.name: pendiente-texto
tokens.usage: Text on `pendiente` stat cards (7.4:1). Dark: #f8e6a0.

tokens.name: descartada
tokens.usage: Soft red — 'Descartada' and 'No asiste' badges, the pressed 'No' RSVP choice, a person tag ('Narvis'). Dark: a deep wine tint (#4a1f24).

tokens.name: descartada-texto
tokens.usage: Text on `descartada` (5.6:1). Dark: #ffb3b3 (8.2:1).

tokens.name: terracota

tokens.name: trazo
tokens.usage: Outline role: the 2px border of cards, inputs, chips, quiet buttons and the tab-bar edge. Light: `mayolica`. Dark: #6f8fd6, which keeps 4.9:1 on `blanco` (the raw blue would sink to 2:1).

tokens.name: accion-texto
tokens.usage: Action as text or line: links, back link, active tab, dashed-button label, accordion sign, fund icon, progress fill, 'Reservado por ti'. Light: `mayolica`. Dark: #9bb7f0 (8.8:1 on fondo).

tokens.name: texto-invertido
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `mayolica` and `profundo` fills (primary button, save-the-date card, sidebar, success banner) — white in both themes.

tokens.name: profundo
tokens.usage: Deep fill role: sidebar, success banner, `Card tone="marino"`. Light: `marino`. Dark: stays the brand navy #1e3a6e so it still reads as a lifted panel over `fondo`.

tokens.name: seleccion
tokens.usage: Selected state fill: chosen segment, active filter chip, current top-nav link, 'Elegida' badge, `Button variant="dark"`. Light: `marino`. Dark: inverts to the light ink.

tokens.name: sobre-seleccion
tokens.usage: Text on `seleccion` (15:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: tinta-fija
tokens.usage: Navy ink on grounds that do not change with the theme — `naranja` (count badges, the success check, the 'N' avatar) and `crema` (the 'foto' label).

tokens.name: lavanda-fija
tokens.usage: Lavender that stays light in both themes: the second partner avatar ('J') on the `profundo` sidebar, with `tinta-fija` initials (6.6:1).

tokens.name: aviso-sobre-azul
tokens.usage: The kicker on the `mayolica` save-the-date card ('Guarda la fecha'), 5.4:1. Light: `pendiente`; dark keeps the same yellow because `pendiente` turns into a dark tint.
